mapper.select: SELECT account_record.account_id, account_record.user_id, DATE(account_record.created_at) AS virtual_investment_started_date, security_holding.security_holding_started_date, account_record.cash_balance AS current_cash, COALESCE(security_holding.current_stock_principal, 0) AS current_stock_principal, COALESCE(product_holding.current_deposit, 0) AS current_deposit, security_holding.average_security_holding_days FROM accounts account_record LEFT JOIN ( SELECT holding_security.account_id, SUM(holding_security.quantity * holding_security.average_price) AS current_stock_principal, MIN(DATE(holding_security.created_at)) AS security_holding_started_date, AVG(DATEDIFF(#{snapshotDate}, DATE(holding_security.created_at))) AS average_security_holding_days FROM holding_securities holding_security WHERE holding_security.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{snapshotDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY holding_security.account_id ) security_holding ON security_holding.account_id = account_record.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT holding_product.account_id, SUM( holding_product.join_amount + COALESCE(product_payment.additional_paid_amount, 0) ) AS current_deposit FROM holding_products holding_product LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_transaction.holding_product_id, SUM(product_transaction.amount) AS additional_paid_amount FROM product_transactions product_transaction WHERE product_transaction.status = 'COMPLETED' AND product_transaction.type IN ( 'PAYMENT', 'ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT' ) AND product_transaction.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{snapshotDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY product_transaction.holding_product_id ) product_payment ON product_payment.holding_product_id = holding_product.holding_product_id WHERE holding_product.status = 'ACTIVE' AND holding_product.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{snapshotDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY holding_product.account_id ) product_holding ON product_holding.account_id = account_record.account_id ORDER BY account_record.account_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_daily_snapshots ( account_id, snapshot_date, current_cash, current_stock_principal, current_deposit, total_invested_principal, cash_ratio ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{currentCash}, #{currentStockPrincipal}, #{currentDeposit}, #{totalInvestedPrincipal}, #{cashRatio} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_cash = VALUES(current_cash), current_stock_principal = VALUES(current_stock_principal), current_deposit = VALUES(current_deposit), total_invested_principal = VALUES(total_invested_principal), cash_ratio = VALUES(cash_ratio), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT account_daily_snapshot_id, account_id, snapshot_date, current_cash, current_stock_principal, current_deposit, total_invested_principal, cash_ratio FROM account_daily_snapshots WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND snapshot_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY snapshot_date
SELECT DATE(MIN(executed_at)) FROM security_orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND executed_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM security_orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND executed_at IS NOT NULL AND executed_at < DATE_ADD(#{assessmentDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
